display_information.name: Orders MCP
display_information.description: Demo Slack app wrapping orders-mcp (an MCP Lens demo server) via the mcp:connect scope.
display_information.long_description: Orders MCP is a development-only Slack app that connects Slack's Slackbot MCP client to the orders-mcp demo server in the mcp-lens repo. It exposes order-management tools (list_orders, get_order, cancel_order, update_shipping_address) plus the MCP Lens surface (show_lens, list_lens_presets, get_lens_preset). Phase 0 of Slackbot MCP is read-only, so cancel_order and update_shipping_address may be suppressed; the read tools and show_lens should be available.
